description: Mirror of pong_for_unsent_id.json from the CLIENT's perspective: a pong arrives for an id the client never sent. OVERVIEW.md section 2.7: 'A pong for an id never sent -> conn PROTOCOL_ERROR.' Uses id 99, same as pong_for_unsent_id.json's server twin, rather than assuming id 0 is unsent: right after welcome the client has not yet sent any ping (its first ping is jittered, OVERVIEW.md section 2.9) so id 0 would also work here, but 99 needs no such timing argument and stays unsent for the fixture's entire duration regardless of jitter or wait_ms -- no wait_ms needed either way.
